name: com.basis.modelpickup
description: Drag and drop a .glb or self-contained .gltf onto the window to spawn a networked, grabbable 3D model pickup. Every model is validated and rebuilt into a canonical GLB before it is loaded, by the sender and again by every receiver. Works over the standard relay with its own uplink budget; a server that provides a model cache serves late joiners from memory, only while the sharer is connected.
